sentences.speaker: Anchor
sentences.text: Bees fly from flower to flower.
sentences.ko: 꿀벌은 이 꽃에서 저 꽃으로 날아다녀요.

sentences.speaker: Anchor
sentences.text: They drink nectar, a sweet juice inside flowers.
sentences.ko: 꽃 안에 있는 달콤한 즙인 꿀물을 마셔요.

sentences.speaker: Anchor
sentences.text: Pollen helps plants make fruit and seeds.
sentences.ko: 꽃가루는 식물이 열매와 씨앗을 만들도록 도와줘요.

sentences.speaker: Anchor
sentences.text: Without bees, we would have fewer apples and berries.
sentences.ko: 꿀벌이 없으면 사과와 베리가 줄어들 거예요.

sentences.speaker: Anchor
sentences.text: So say thank you to the bees!
